name: Alchemist's Talent
clause: Treasures you control have "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add two mana of any one color." / Whenever you cast a spell, if mana from a Treasure was spent to cast it, this Class deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to each opponent.

needs.proposedSignature: `Ability.atLevel?: number` on every Ability kind, read by abilitiesOf (activated / triggered / spell) and by computeStaticMods (static), so an ability printed below a Class's level-N bar functions only while the source's level is >= N
needs.semantics: CR 716.2e: an ability a Class gains from its level-N bar is active only while the Class is level N or greater. Today the only carriers of a level gate are the `condition` field on anthem / self-keywords / self-pt and on the cost-alter family's cost-alter static. Every other static kind under a level bar — extra-land, grant-ability, grant-mana-ability, damage-replacement, play-lands-from, counters-replacement, no-max-hand-size — is either unwritable or silently active from level 1. This is the single biggest blocker in the batch (5 of 12 blocked cards) and docs/vocabulary/piles-choices.md §5 already names it as deliberately absent.
needs.clause: Noncreature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast. / You may play an additional land on each of your turns. / Treasures you control have "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add two mana of any one color."

needs.proposedSignature: condition `{ kind: 'mana-spent-from', filter: Filter }` (usable as a triggered ability's `intervening`), backed by a per-mana tag recording the id and characteristics of the permanent that produced it, carried through payment onto the StackItem
needs.semantics: 'If mana from a Treasure was spent to cast it', 'using mana produced by ~'. Amount.count already has colors-spent, so the pool carries colour provenance; this is the object-level version. The Brass's Tunnel-Grinder blocked note (data/scripts/blocked/af/af1553eb-…) asks for the same thing, so it serves the whole 'spent mana matters' family.
needs.clause: Whenever you cast a spell, if mana from a Treasure was spent to cast it, this Class deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to each opponent.
